keyPointsEn: RSI has exited oversold and is consolidating in the neutral zone, while the MACD histogram shows improvement but has not yet turned positive, indicating a weak reversal signal.
Volume ratio below 1 for 5 consecutive days suggests weak buying interest, reducing the reliability of current price movements.

The current price ($36.44) is below the SMA20 ($37.89) and Bollinger Band mid-band ($37.89), facing short-term resistance, with a narrow gap to the swing support ($36.03) indicating potential for increased volatility.
